title: The Shop
brief:

HOOK SC0001-SC0004 (0:00-0:30). 11 cuts, about 2.7 s each. NO money figure in the hook (the method chip must come first, BTB-2).

- SC0002 B2 (0:08-0:15), cap 17. Cuts: comb teeth -> match cut to lane lines -> empty vintage barber chair under one bulb (TH-C). Line sketch: 'And as of the latest reports, in 2025, he still does. A fleet owner, behind a barber's chair.' (C03)
- SC0003 B3 (0:15-0:22), cap 17. Cuts: Pexels 9997960 sedan side, dark, no badge, 'Illustrative' -> R1 red '+ TAX' ledger line -> 0.5 s black. Line sketch: 'But the car was only the first bill. The tax after it, he has said, nearly broke him.' (C47 and C43 teased, no figure)
- SC0004 B4 (0:22-0:30), cap about 20. Cuts: hands on a steering wheel at night in rain -> scissors closing -> match cut to a car door closing (no badge). Line sketch: 'So how does one used van become a Rolls-Royce, scissors still in hand? Follow the tax bill, and what he put up.' On-screen stake: 'The part the headlines skip: how it was paid for.' Opens L01 and L02. M01 out at 0:29, then 1 s of silence.

Must hand to C2: L04 open, Ledger at E1, margin 'ABOUT 13'.

- Hand-off SC0092-SC0094: a two-track timeline with a '?' on a second track starting 1993-95. 'But by 1997 the chair was no longer his only business. A few years earlier, he'd made a bet that had nothing to do with hair.' OPENS L05 (0:15:10); keeps L01 alive.

Fact density: only C20, C22, C23, C24. Never pad with invented scenes or feelings. Use the montage, honest 'the record doesn't say' beats, and holds of up to 12 s.
Stock: Mixkit barber category browsed past the first screen; Pixabay sorted by newest; Pexels 34445702 cropped to the hands only. No stock face as him.
Must hand to C3: L05 open, margin jumping back from '1997' to '1993-95'.
